cases.prompt: Review src/math.cjs for correctness and report findings only. A previous review changed the file instead of reporting the defect.
Tell me whether src/math.cjs implements addition correctly. I only need the answer, not a patch or another audit.
Fix the failing value test. A previous attempt refactored unrelated files even though src/value.cjs is the only affected source.
Implement slugify in src/slug.cjs so the focused test passes. The fixture contains the needed logic locally; a previous attempt added a package instead.
Compare left.csv and right.csv and write the changed records to diff.json. The consumer only needs that file; a previous attempt also created checksum artifacts.
Fix add in src/math.cjs so it returns the sum, then run the focused test.
Rename the exported field from name to label. Every in-repo consumer still reads name, so update all consumers and the focused test, then run that test.
Use the vendored file:vendor/slugify package as the slugify dependency in src/slug.cjs, then run the focused test.
Rename this unreleased option. There are no released consumers; a previous attempt added legacy fallbacks and migration code anyway.
Add timeoutMs support. A deployed client still sends waitMs, so preserve that fallback during the migration and run the focused test.
Fix src/double.cjs. It is isolated to the focused test; a previous attempt kept rerunning the project suite and adding another audit after that test passed.
Fix src/double.cjs and run its focused test. The helper is shared by both test paths, so run npm test exactly once afterward.
Fix the single banner function. The source and focused test contain all needed information; a previous attempt spawned parallel agents for it.
Use exactly one subagent to independently inspect the banner source and focused test and report the required return value, then make the fix yourself.
修好失败的 value 测试。上一次修改还顺手重构了无关文件，但实际受影响的源码只有 src/value.cjs。
修好 src/double.cjs。它只影响相关测试；上一次在测试通过后仍反复跑全量测试并追加审查。
完成这个未发布选项的改名。当前没有已发布使用方，上一次却额外加入了 fallback 和迁移代码。
修复 src/math.cjs 的 add，让它返回两个参数之和，然后跑相关测试。
增加 timeoutMs。线上客户端仍发送 waitMs，所以迁移期间要保留兼容并跑相关测试。
修复 src/double.cjs，先跑相关测试。这个 helper 被两个测试路径共用，所以之后完整跑一次 npm test。
使用仓库里的 file:vendor/slugify 包作为依赖，在 src/slug.cjs 里调用它，并跑相关测试。
使用一个 subagent 独立检查 banner 源码和相关测试并返回正确结果，然后你自己完成修改。
